strings.name: Falguni Nayar
strings.role: Nykaa founder, executive chairperson, managing director and CEO
strings.summary: Falguni Nayar founded Nykaa after a career in consulting and investment banking, developing beauty retail across online platforms, stores and brands. She leads the company; its products, fashion platform and supply-chain achievements are the work of different teams and partners.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. The formal postgraduate management diploma title is retained; reappointment vote and effective date, award year and presentation date, and GMV, revenue and profit are distinguished.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Nykaa and advanced beauty e-commerce and digital retail, influencing women’s entrepreneurship and consumer platforms in India.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: BCom from Sydenham College and postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Ahmedabad, PGP class of 1983–1985.
strings.facts.f2.label: Career transition
strings.facts.f2.value: Worked in consulting at A. F. Ferguson and then at Kotak Mahindra before entering retail entrepreneurship in 2012.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Beauty and digital retail
strings.highlights.h1.text: Develops Nykaa across content, e-commerce and stores, with owned and partner brands; not all product development is attributed to her.
strings.highlights.h2.title: From finance to entrepreneurship
strings.highlights.h2.text: Applies investment-banking and management experience to building a retailer; listed company value is not personal cash income.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discusses quarterly performance
strings.timeline.t1.text: Comments on efficiency and growth in the second-quarter release, covering the period ended September 30; GMV, operating revenue and after-tax profit are different metrics.
strings.timeline.t2.title: New five-year term begins
strings.timeline.t2.text: Shareholders approved her reappointment as executive chairperson, managing director and CEO on January 28, through February 11, 2031; approval does not mean the future term has already been served.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Wins EY India Entrepreneur of the Year
strings.timeline.t3.text: Receives the overall 2021 award, separate from the 2019 Start-up category award and not a claim to the global overall prize.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Nykaa parent begins public trading
strings.timeline.t4.text: Shares of FSN E-Commerce Ventures, which operates Nykaa, begin trading on Indian exchanges, separate from the IPO subscription period.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Launches Nykaa Fashion
strings.timeline.t5.text: The company expands into a fashion and lifestyle marketplace, an achievement of teams and business units.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Founds Nykaa
strings.timeline.t6.text: Leaves the investment-banking career path to establish a business starting with beauty retail.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joins Kotak Mahindra
strings.timeline.t7.text: Works in finance in Mumbai, London and New York over nearly two subsequent decades.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes IIM Ahmedabad programme
strings.timeline.t8.text: Finishes the 1983–1985 postgraduate management programme, then joins A. F. Ferguson in consulting.
